tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-6

Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian manifold, and $\gamma : I \to M$ is a regular (but not necessarily unit-speed) curve in $M$. Show that the geodesic curvature of $\gamma $ at $t \in I$ is \[ \kappa (t) = \frac{|\gamma '(t) \times D_t \gamma '(t)|}{|\gamma '(t)|^3}, \] where the norm in the numerator is the one defined by (8.27). Show also that in $\mathbb {R}^3$ with the Euclidean metric, the formula can be written \[ \kappa (t) = \frac{|\gamma '(t) \times \gamma ''(t)|}{|\gamma '(t)|^3}. \] \end{exercise}
